summary: Alamos Gold Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 21, 2026, announcing management appointments: James Clark as VP Canadian Operations, Marcelo Martinez (promoted to VP Mexico Operations), Scott R.G. Parsons (promoted to SVP Exploration), and Adrian Paulse (promoted to SVP Information Technology). These are routine executive-level promotions and a new hire, not a forced or abrupt departure. There are no specific terms (stake, price), board recommendation, advisors, or deal mechanics. The filing is a standard management update. What to watch: typical succession planning. As a non-US filer, this 6-K serves as a current report.
